Description.SourceString:
Observation log: We have come upon a dreary, boring place, Sir. I have tried to keep my comrades occupied by tasking them with observing its inhabitants, but those inhabitants mostly stare at walls, slack-jawed. It doesn't help that penguins are ghostblind, either. I am told that there are ghosts here, but neither I nor my comrades are capable of seeing them.

Agent Orecchiette even bravely volunteered to experience The Withering, Sir. Remind me to nominate her for a medal. She returned with a shrug and said that she saw the world in negative, so her white belly was black and her black jacket was white. It was fun for a holiday, but she wouldn't want to live there. Those were her words.

The opportunities for intelligence-gathering are limited, Sir. We will leave a small contingent to observe the expedition and move on.

Threat assessment: Low - my comrades have taken to calling it Dullhollow.

End of report.

- Agent Ravioli
